payload.title: Test Qwen-native Retina feature reuse as a ClayCode VisualPercept path into self.root on the target VPS
payload.work_clay: Implement an H1-grade matched visual benchmark around the current Qwen3.5-4B abliterated Q4_K_M + mmproj lane on the target VPS. Capture the libmtmd image embedding buffer before LLM decode, derive deterministic pooled MVC-Q0 descriptors and optionally a bounded MVC-Q1 projection/readout, then compare FULL_QWEN, dedicated-feature MVC baseline, QNDRF feature reuse, ROI/token-budget and action-grounded-memory variants. On escalation, prove whether already-computed mtmd embeddings can feed the same Qwen decode without rerunning visual encoding. Every semantic output crossing into cognition must be normalized as typed ClayCode VisualPercept/PerceptualField; Qwen captions, OCR strings, embeddings or German descriptions are evidence/backing only, never a second authoritative cognitive plane. Live screen/camera/browser sources must follow secure transport -> API token auth -> client/session/provenance -> Retina/Qwen physical vision -> ClayCode VisualPercept -> self.root. Frozen fixtures may bypass network/auth only for deterministic compute-path differentials and must not be confused with live acceptance. Preserve exact target host, self.root binary/state identity where available, API/session/client provenance, model/mmproj/runtime hashes, visual token counts, frame/ROI identity, latency, CPU/RAM/swap/storage/network, false-familiarity/open-set metrics, ClayCode semantic fidelity, action outcomes and crash/replay receipts.
payload.reason_clay: The latest owner directives make self.root the sole native cognitive identity, Frank the human-facing name, and ClayCode the only authoritative cognitive language. This changes the acceptance question for Qwen-native vision: the best architecture is not merely the cheapest image understanding path, but the cheapest path that preserves Retina temporal/provenance functions and produces lossless ClayCode-native percepts before GWT/memory/self.root cognition. A natural-language caption layer that becomes authoritative would now violate the target architecture even if accurate. Existing libmtmd feature reuse still offers a plausible major simplification, but generative-VLM features remain unproven for calibrated MVC/open-set use.
payload.completion_clay: A target-VPS report compares identical visual fixtures across all variants and proves/falsifies zero-duplicate image encoding. It separately measures secure live ingress, mmproj encode, MVC/readout, ClayCode VisualPercept construction/validation, self.root cognitive use and total sensor-to-correct-outcome latency. It reports semantic-field/entity/relation/negation/quantity/provenance preservation into ClayCode, false familiarity/unknown/conflict, ROI/small-text failures, stale feature-version rejection and service/API recovery. It verifies that German translation is not required for non-language visual cognition and that any human-facing caption is derived downstream from ClayCode rather than used as canonical perceptual truth. Disposition: SUPPORTED, REVISE, REFUTED or NO_CHANGE for replacing the separate heavy deep-vision backbone with Qwen-native features while preserving Retina control functions.
payload.executor_policy: Primary performance/correctness runs on the Hostinger target VPS. Live multimodal acceptance uses the production-shaped token-authenticated API; frozen fixtures isolate compute mechanisms. Never persist raw production tokens. Core cognitive input/output must remain ClayCode-only; do not promote a natural-language caption/OCR string to canonical perceptual state. If no GPU is present, treat that as the current target constraint unless an explicit migration/accelerator architecture is authorized and measured. Refresh all owner directives, repo head, active work and runtime/model versions before effect. No paid training.
invalidators: A newer target-VPS receipt already proves the same Qwen feature-reuse plus ClayCode-percept differential
Current model/runtime no longer supports the measured multimodal interception path
